name: supplychain
description: AWS Supply Chain is a cloud-based application that works with your enterprise resource planning (ERP) and supply chain management systems.

subcommands.name: create-bill-of-materials-import-job
subcommands.description: CreateBillOfMaterialsImportJob creates an import job for the Product Bill Of Materials (BOM) entity.

subcommands.name: create-data-integration-flow
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically create a data pipeline to ingest data from source systems such as Amazon S3 buckets, to a predefined Amazon Web Services Supply Chain dataset (product, inbound_order) or a temporary dataset along with the data transformation query provided with the API.

subcommands.name: create-data-lake-dataset
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically create an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain data lake dataset.

subcommands.name: create-data-lake-namespace
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically create an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain data lake namespace.

subcommands.name: create-instance
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically create an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instance by applying KMS keys and relevant information associated with the API without using the Amazon Web Services console.

subcommands.name: delete-data-integration-flow
subcommands.description: Enable you to programmatically delete an existing data pipeline for the provided Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instance and DataIntegrationFlow name.

subcommands.name: delete-data-lake-dataset
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically delete an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain data lake dataset.

subcommands.name: delete-data-lake-namespace
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically delete an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain data lake namespace and its underling datasets.

subcommands.name: delete-instance
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically delete an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instance by deleting the KMS keys and relevant information associated with the API without using the Amazon Web Services console.

subcommands.name: get-bill-of-materials-import-job
subcommands.description: Get status and details of a BillOfMaterialsImportJob.

subcommands.name: get-data-integration-event
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically view an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain Data Integration Event.

subcommands.name: get-data-integration-flow
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically view a specific data pipeline for the provided Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instance and DataIntegrationFlow name.

subcommands.name: get-data-integration-flow-execution
subcommands.description: Get the flow execution.

subcommands.name: get-data-lake-dataset
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically view an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain data lake dataset.

subcommands.name: get-data-lake-namespace
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically view an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain data lake namespace.

subcommands.name: get-instance
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically retrieve the information related to an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instance ID.

subcommands.name: list-data-integration-events
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically list all data integration events for the provided Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instance.

subcommands.name: list-data-integration-flow-executions
subcommands.description: List flow executions.

subcommands.name: list-data-integration-flows
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically list all data pipelines for the provided Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instance.

subcommands.name: list-data-lake-datasets
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically view the list of Amazon Web Services Supply Chain data lake datasets.

subcommands.name: list-data-lake-namespaces
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically view the list of Amazon Web Services Supply Chain data lake namespaces.

subcommands.name: list-instances
subcommands.description: List all Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instances for a specific account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List all the tags for an Amazon Web ServicesSupply Chain resource.

subcommands.name: send-data-integration-event
subcommands.description: Send the data payload for the event with real-time data for analysis or monitoring.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: You can create tags during or after creating a resource such as instance, data flow, or dataset in AWS Supply chain.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: You can delete tags for an Amazon Web Services Supply chain resource such as instance, data flow, or dataset in AWS Supply Chain.

subcommands.name: update-data-integration-flow
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically update an existing data pipeline to ingest data from the source systems such as, Amazon S3 buckets, to a predefined Amazon Web Services Supply Chain dataset (product, inbound_order) or a temporary dataset along with the data transformation query provided with the API.

subcommands.name: update-data-lake-dataset
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically update an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain data lake dataset.

subcommands.name: update-data-lake-namespace
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically update an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain data lake namespace.

subcommands.name: update-instance
subcommands.description: Enables you to programmatically update an Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instance description by providing all the relevant information such as account ID, instance ID and so on without using the AWS console.
